messages:
Maya S: quick follow-up from last night's postmortem — telemetry ETL lag + missing spans. we agreed on fixes but need explicit owners and timelines so these don't slip. root cause summary: ETL checkpoint regression + aggregator dedup edge-case. tagging action items here.

Ryan K: I can own the ETL checkpoint fix. plan: reproduce locally, add idempotent checkpointing, open PR for review. ETA: Fri EOD.

Sophia L: I will take the aggregation dedup bug. looks like a race when flush() runs concurrently. adding unit tests + integration canary. ETA: next Tue.

Alex P: +1. also proposing two product-side mitigations: 1) alert on span-loss rate, 2) daily parity check between raw events and aggregated spans. SQL parity check snippet: ```SELECT date_trunc('hour', ts) as hr, count(*) raw, agg.count spans FROM raw_events r LEFT JOIN agg_hourly agg ON hr = agg.hour GROUP BY hr, agg.count HAVING abs(count(*) - coalesce(agg.count,0)) > 50;```

observability-bot: Incident INC-2026-0421-17 created and postmortem uploaded: https://redwood.internal/postmortems/INC-2026-0421-17 :memo:

Maya S: adding infra audit for Kinesis/backoff configs — @Infra Team can you look at retries and consumer parallelism? suspect backpressure amplified missing spans.

Infra Team: Infra Team here — will run an audit of producer/consumer retry policies, batching sizes, and retention. aim to deliver findings by Mon EOD.

Ryan K: thanks. I'll coordinate the staging canary once infra confirms safe replay window.

Sophia L: observed pattern: span loss spikes when batch_size > 1024 and sequence numbers fall behind. adding test that simulates partial ACKs.

Alex P: scheduling a recurring 30m "telemetry hygiene" sync to track recurring incident patterns and action-item rollups; first meeting next Wed 10:00am. will invite owners.

Maya S: action items (short):
- ETL checkpoint idempotency — owner: Ryan K — due: Fri EOD (1761594290)
- Aggregator dedup/race fix + tests — owner: Sophia L — due: Tue (1761973490)
- Infra retry/backoff audit — owner: Infra Team — due: Mon EOD (1761580800)
- Span-loss alert + parity job — owner: Alex P — due: Thu (1761667200)

Maya S: please reply with ack or if dates unrealistic. we should also add a small telemetry postmortem dashboard in Console to track recurrence (slo: span-loss <0.05%).

Ryan K: ack, will add PR link here when ready.

Sophia L: ack, will add the canary run results to the postmortem doc.

Alex P: ack, will create the parity job in airflow and link DAG.

Maya S: thanks everyone — i'll update the postmortem with these owners/timelines and mark follow-ups. if anything slips, escalate in #incidents. :thumbsup:
